categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Gian Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in six business segments: Metal Manufacturing (focusing on Metal Injection Molding (MIM) components and assemblies), Power Components (precision rotational and transmission components), Precision Plastics (plastic parts and assemblies for automotive and consumer electronics), Thermal Management Products (cooling modules including air and liquid cooling), Intelligent Manufacturing Services (automation and system integration), and Electronic Manufacturing (smart audio devices including TWS earphones). The company serves diverse industries including consumer electronics, automotive, smart home, and industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced Metal Injection Molding (MIM) technology combined with CNC machining, 3D printing, heat treatment, polishing, and coating processes for precision metal parts. It develops high-strength lightweight metal materials such as titanium alloys and high-strength steels. The power segment focuses on micro-gear transmission and brushless DC motors. Thermal management solutions include air and liquid cooling modules with heat pipes and vapor chambers. The company also emphasizes digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in consumer electronics (smartphones, foldable phones, wearable devices), automotive manufacturers (especially in the new energy vehicle sector), smart home appliance brands (notably in cleaning robots), and industrial clients in edge computing and energy storage. The company serves markets in North America, South Korea, China, and expanding overseas regions, with a strong presence in domestic Chinese markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, with subsidiaries and operations extending to Guangdong, Shanghai, Hong Kong, the United States (California), Vietnam, and Singapore. Its sales and manufacturing footprint covers domestic Chinese regions including South China and East China, as well as significant export markets in North America and other international locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Gian Technology operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of core metal and plastic components, precision transmission modules, and thermal management products. It also extends downstream by producing end products such as smart audio devices and providing integrated manufacturing services, positioning itself as a comprehensive supplier from components to system-level solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-strength lightweight metal materials, advanced MIM processes, precision transmission systems, and thermal management technologies. It invests heavily in R&D with over 8% of revenue allocated to research, focusing on titanium alloys, ceramic-metal bonding, ultra-high strength steels, and high-polish materials for consumer electronics. Strategic initiatives include digitalization, automation, AI integration, and expanding into emerging fields like foldable smartphones, AR/VR devices, robotics, and 3D printing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision metal and plastic components, assemblies, and end products to OEMs and brand customers. The company operates on a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders and production plans with a combination of in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing. It also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Gian Technology is recognized as a leading domestic and global player in the MIM industry, holding a strong market position with advanced technology and stable customer relationships. It competes with other precision component manufacturers in consumer electronics and automotive sectors. The company has been awarded national manufacturing champion status and high-tech enterprise certifications, underscoring its competitive edge in technology, quality, and service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.16 billion, a slight decrease of 1.66% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 119.7 million, down 28.02%. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 3.28 billion and equity exceeding RMB 2.15 billion. Despite some profit decline, the company continues to invest significantly in R&D and operational efficiency, aiming for sustainable growth and diversification across multiple business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-strength, and lightweight metal and plastic components tailored to customer-specific needs, leveraging proprietary MIM technology and advanced materials. It offers integrated solutions combining metal manufacturing, precision transmission, thermal management, and intelligent manufacturing services, enabling customers to achieve product miniaturization, performance enhancement, and cost reduction. Its rapid response capability, full-process control, and cross-segment innovation provide differentiated value and strong customer loyalty.
